scoring_justification: The task produces a self-contained JSON of computed adsorption properties. The checker compares each field to paper-reported gold within tolerances, and enforces structural trends (Eads ordering, magnetic moment sign). No intermediate raw artifact can be recomputed; therefore T0 is appropriate.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for adsorption properties taken from paper Table 2
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2 in Materials Chemistry and Physics 2019, DOI 10.1016/j.matchemphys.2019.04.003
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from paper's Table 2 for the four post-adsorption systems: pristine/NO, Fe/NO, Ru/NO, Os/NO.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported quantities for the systems under the same computational conditions; they serve as the authoritative reference for a reproduction.

outputs.description: Compiled DFT adsorption properties for the four post-adsorption systems (pristine/NO, Fe/NO, Ru/NO, Os/NO).

output_contract.notes: The checker compares each numeric field against the paper's Table 2 values using appropriate tolerances and enforces structural trends (e.g., adsorption energies of TM-embedded systems more negative than pristine, Os-embedded most negative).

steps.description: Check all numeric fields against hidden gold within tolerances and enforce structural trends.
